description: Ordered phases for each project flow. Single source of truth for phase ids, shared by the TypeScript core and the Rust app. A skill's "phases" list uses these ids, or ["all"] for skills that apply to every phase.
planningDescription: Phases that must include a confirmed Understanding check when submitted (UND-1).

optional.security-pass: The build is done and ready to deploy. Before deploying, run a red-team / blue-team pass to tighten security?

optionalDescription: Phases a person may decline (GATE-1, SEC-1). Each maps to the question the person is asked. Only a person can start (agree to) or skip (decline) one; a skip is recorded.
